reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: But the smile says it all.
After losing his first five tour level finals,
he's now won two in a row.
And this one came having not played a match
for two and a half months.

review_note: 同一条：他转身振臂、蹲下捂脸。两档转写（small.en / medium.en）逐词一致（441.32–455.58，按 small 断句）。段首 441.0 在 did you not（440.08）之后，段尾 456.0 在 What a week（455.80）只露半个词，字幕收到 455.58。
